title: Detections of [O III] 88 μm in two quasars in the reionization epoch
question: Is [OIII] 88 um detectable in z~6 quasars, and what are their [OIII]/[CII] ratios and [OIII]/L_TIR deficit behaviour?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 67 (106) uJy/beam; line cube 0.6 (0.8) mJy/beam per 30 km/s

what.value: [CII] luminosities, sizes, FWHM and ALMA 262 GHz continuum

evidence.quote: and MAMBO 250 GHz data ((cite: wang2008)), respectively

what.value: Literature [OIII]/L_TIR compilations (DGS, SHINING, spirals, SMGs, z>7 objects)

evidence.quote: taken from the Herschel DGS ((cite: cormier2015)) and SHINING ((cite: herrera-camus2018a)) samples

recipe.method: CASA pipeline calibration, CLEAN natural weighting, uvcontsub for line cube, collapse off-line channels for continuum
Moment image over line range, imfit 2D Gaussian; spectrum extracted from >3 sigma region

recipe.goal: Fit dust SED for Td, beta, L_TIR, SFR_IR
recipe.method: Optically thin modified blackbody with CMB correction fit to Herschel, ALMA, MAMBO photometry; chi2; integrate 8-1000 um
assumptions: Optically thin single-temperature dust; Kroupa IMF 0.1-100 Msun; dust emission star-formation powered (upper limit on SFR)

recipe.method: Recalibrate SDSS z-band with Gaia DR2 via IRAF ccmap/ccsetwcs; positions by imexam
Compute L[OIII]/L_TIR and L[OIII]/L[CII]; compare SFR_OIII (De Looze ULIRG relation) with SFR_IR

evidence.quote: the total line flux is estimated to be $3.79\pm0.34$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
the FWHM value of $282\pm17$ km s$^{-1}$ ($333\pm72$ km s$^{-1}$)

answer_key.quantity: Continuum flux density at 87 um rest

evidence.quote: we obtain the line luminosity ratio of $2.1\pm0.4$ ($0.3\pm0.1$)
